title: Total work answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for total work done by the gas must be 1500 J.

title: Isobaric work expression
description: Important Criteria: The work for the isobaric process A→B must be correctly expressed as W₁ = -P(V_B - V_A) or equivalent.

title: Adiabatic work from ΔU
description: Important Criteria: The work for the adiabatic process B→C must be correctly identified as equal to the change in internal energy, W₂ = ΔU.

title: Sign for work on surroundings
description: Important Criteria: The total work done *by the gas on the surroundings* must be calculated with correct sign convention (e.g., W_total = -(W₁ + W₂) if W₁ and W₂ are defined as work done *on* the gas).

title: Use of given ΔU
description: Important Criteria: The given decrease in internal energy (-900 J) for process B→C must be correctly substituted into the adiabatic work relation.

title: Units included
description: Optional Criteria: The final answer should include the correct unit (Joules).

title: Sign confusion in ΔU
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly using ΔU = +900 J instead of -900 J for the adiabatic process.

title: Misinterpreting work direction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Confusing work done *by* the gas with work done *on* the gas in the final summation, leading to a sign error.
